section-projects.client-projects-descrip: At Damocle'Sword, we have a specialized department that offers services to other companies looking to integrate virtual reality into their business objectives. We contact them, provide a proposal tailored to their specific needs, and then carry out the project for them.
section-vision.business-talk:
We envision ourselves as a company willing to do whatever it takes to create an excellent work environment that brings out the best in each of our members and reflects it in our VR games. 

With our talent, effort, and love for video games, we will create a full range of the highest quality VR video games.

section-who-we-are.body:
We are a studio born from the passion of a group of university students who, at some point in their journey, decided to enter the world of video games by creating their own — specifically using a technology that is not yet standardized: virtual reality.

Our purpose? It's clear: to develop games that motivate us while offering our community and the world new experiences that haven't been seen before.

Dreamers? Maybe. But with effort and love for our products, we are willing to do everything possible to reach those dreams. That's Damocle'Sword.
section-our-values.intro: At Damocle'Sword, we are very clear about who we are and how we are. That's why we believe it's important to communicate the values that define us as a studio, always staying true to them at all times.
section-our-values.quality-description: We always give our best, striving to learn and improve with each development. We want even the most critical audience to recognize our effort and care.
section-our-values.responsibility-descri: We are aware that our games can have social repercussions, and we always take this into account, being responsible for what we do.
section-our-values.respect-description: We respect the needs of our team and always strive to do what's best for everyone.
section-our-values.curiosity-description: We are always looking to experiment with new concepts and technologies, we love to create and learn new things.
section-future.body:
We are a team with high expectations for our future journey, striving every day to achieve our goal.

In the future (not too far away), Damocle'Sword will be a great Spanish company capable of developing multiple projects simultaneously and having a large team with whom we can learn and develop.

We also envision a plan to support other projects through publishing and offering development services to other companies in the sector, as well as expanding into cultural development, offering experiences to museums, sports, etc.
section-what-we-do.intro:
Our customer services specialize in integrating interactive technology that offers reality within the ecosystem and objectives of each company that decides to work with us.

We handle the development proposals based on each client's needs, always prioritizing their business objectives and the contribution our product can make to their brand. We also manage the proposed development, working diligently to create the best possible product tailored to the client's goals.
section-what-we-do.approach-1-descriptio: We deal directly with each client, keeping communication open so the product truly matches their vision and objectives.
section-what-we-do.approach-2-descriptio: We build every product to professional standards while constantly looking for innovative solutions that set it apart.
section-what-we-do.approach-3-descriptio: We continuously research emerging technologies to keep our products at the cutting edge of the industry.
section-how-we-work.intro:
At Damocle'Sword we always strive for customer satisfaction through our services, adapting to their vision and objectives for the product to be developed, always in accordance with a methodology that allows us to contact the customer regularly.

Before starting a project, we carry out the following phases:
section-how-we-work.phase-1: We meet with you to understand your goals and needs.
section-how-we-work.phase-2: We developed a proposal consistent with the objectives, which establishes:
section-how-we-work.phase-2-item-3: Time and estimated budget for each block
section-how-we-work.phase-3: Following this, we regularly show progress updates to allow room for any necessary adaptations or changes.
section-how-we-work.characteristics-titl: Characteristics of the projects we carry out:
section-how-we-work.feature-1-descriptio: They are prepared to grow and adapt, reducing the typical problems of a fixed development such as the need to add new content to the project.
section-how-we-work.feature-2-descriptio: Being modular, we adapt the project to the needs of budget and development time.
section-where-we-fit.intro: Thanks to the capabilities offered by the technology we specialize in (virtual reality) and our knowledge of video games and gamification, our products are perfectly suited to different types of needs:
section-where-we-fit.fit-1-description: Our products fit perfectly within the diversification plans of technology companies. Virtual reality technology allows for the creation of large quantities of projects tailored to the specific technologies of each company.
section-where-we-fit.fit-2-description: With the rise of technological integration of gaming into cultural aspects, virtual reality can play a very valuable role in this sector. From interactive museums to virtual tours of important locations, everything is possible.
section-where-we-fit.fit-3-description: The immersion and interactivity offered by virtual reality makes it perfect for training programs. Depending on the training objectives each company needs, several projects can be proposed to address those needs.
section-where-we-fit.fit-4-description: We also integrate gamification into our projects, using game theory to foster interest and focus among users in the projects carried out.
section-where-we-fit.closing: Additionally, if you don't see your type of company reflected in these sections but believe we can offer value, we invite you to contact us so we can explore the different options available. We are always open to new developments.
section-projects-detailed.realistic-inte: A simulator that tests realism in virtual environments, both in terms of graphics and interactions with the generated environment. An ongoing development that strives for pure realism; a showcase of our development and design capabilities.
section-projects-detailed.vr-sickness-re: A test designed to reduce dizziness caused by exposure to VR, consisting of 5 phases where the intensity is gradually increased; the gradual approach reduces symptoms.
